token_matching.rule: A token matches only when the characters immediately before and after the candidate are not ASCII token characters.
applies_to: canonical/aliases of tags whose match_policy is token_exact
ASCII aliases of length 3 or less, including PT, OT and ST

allowance_suffix_variants.scope: Insert the optional particle immediately before the terminal allowance suffix of canonical, strict aliases, and loose aliases. The generated variant keeps the original confidence level.

welcome_application_variants.scope: Only tags in middle_category 応募歓迎. Derive from canonical/aliases ending in 歓迎, excluding 大歓迎 and 応募歓迎 so generated variants do not recursively expand.
welcome_application_variants.confidence_rule: Variants from a loose source remain loose. force_loose_suffixes are always review candidates even when derived from a strict source.

review: フリーターも応募可能

presence_absence_suffix_variants.confidence_rule: Generated variants keep the source confidence.

negative.short_kanji_boundary_rule: The single-kanji 無 variant matches only when immediately followed by end-of-text, whitespace, or punctuation. This prevents false positives such as 駐車場無料.

positive.short_kanji_boundary_rule: The single-kanji 有 variant matches only when immediately followed by end-of-text, whitespace, or punctuation. This prevents false positives such as 残業有無.

activity_variants.scope: Tags whose canonical ends with 活躍中. Apply to canonical and aliases that themselves end with 活躍中.
activity_variants.strict_suffix_change: 活躍中 -> 活躍, preserving the source confidence.
activity_variants.loose_suffix_change: 活躍中 -> 在籍, always review.

location_matching.purpose: 求人内容を厳密に分類するのではなく、広告マッチング上の合理的な関連性を持つ就業場所シグナルを抽出する。文字列の偶然一致は抑止し、配送先・訪問先などは原則reviewへ弱める。
